Our recruits are the finest in the field!|audio = Moltenwave-24.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 24 (Formerly, [[Molten Mode|Molten]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Elite Molten''' is a stronger version of the [[Molten]], which appears in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It has rather low health for its debut and slightly fast speed. It is also [[Burn Immunity|Burn Immune]], meaning it cannot be set on fire, and [[Freeze Immunity|Freeze Immune]], making it immune to freeze and chillness. ==Appereance== The '''Elite Molten''' has neon orange red skin, which is lava. Its legs and torso is covered in molten rock, with a large crack on its torso and some small cracks on the legs. It also has multiple molten rocks sticking out of its body. On its arms, it has two grey arm-bands with grey spikes and chains on them. ==Strategy== *Towers with high DPS like the [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]], [[Crook Boss]] or [[Turret]] can mod down large hordes of '''Elite Moltens''' due to their high DPS. **The [[Ranger]] and [[Engineer]] can also partially bypass its defense through splash damage. *The [[Military Base]]'s [[units]] can easily soak up several collisions with '''Elite Moltens''', due to their collision damage bypassing its defense. *While towers that deal fire damage like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Trapper]] cannot burn the '''Elite Molten''', they can still deal non-burn damage to it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} EliteMoltenStun.gif|Current stun animation (11 December 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1EliteMolten.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker2EliteMolten.png|Overclock variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} EliteCorpse.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tower Defense Simulator - "Prepare Your Defenses" Trailer|'''Elite Molten''' on a promotional video. Enforcer Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Elite Molten''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexEliteMolten.png|'''Elite Molten''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''11 December 2024''' - [[v1.45.0]] **'''Elite Molten''' added. **{{Bug}} [[Jester]]'s defense dropping does not reduce '''Elite Molten's''' defense. *'''12 September 2025''' - [[v1.74.0|v1.74.3a]] **Now appears in [[Sk8 P4rk]] Master difficulty as part of [[The Takeover Event]]. ***Has 500 health in [[Sk8 P4rk]]. *'''22 September 2025''' - [[v1.74.0|v1.74.3g]] **No longer appears in [[Sk8 P4rk]], as it has been removed. *'''28 January 2026''' - [[v1.84.0]] **First wave appearance changed from 24 to 27 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode. **Health increased from 500 to 1,000. **Cash given increased from {{Money|450}} to {{Money|1,400}} on death. **[[Defense]] removed. **[[Freeze Immunity]] added. {{Molten|[[Breaker4]]|Wave 26|Elite Molten|Wave 27|[[Molten Executioner]]|Wave 30}} {{TakeoverMaster|[[Bulwark]] & [[Tanker]]|Wave 17|Elite Molten|Wave 18|[[Molten Executioner]]|Wave 20}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Late-Game]]
